answer: Sybil resistance here rests on reversible staked bonds tied to each identity. An agent joins by locking funds in a shared vault, and every signature must carry a proof-of-knowledge cipher keyed to that locked key. A single honest agent can also collect a pigment of vouches from peers, but each voucher is finite and slashable. To run N sockpuppets an attacker must fund N separate locks and answer N keyed proofs, so cost scales linearly with the puppet count while rewards do not.
